learning_outcomes.text: Students understand the basics of Wireless Security on the Physical-Layer (cf. OSI-Model) and can apply them practically.
Students learn how radio signals are transmitted and how to handle them practically for communication purposes.
Students learn how radio connections can be used as (hidden) sensors, enabling practical applications and various privacy attacks.
Students examine security primitives based on radio connections.
Students learn the setup and handling of modern measurement technology.
Students gain basic insights into machine learning and data analysis, especially with practical application in the WPLS area.

syllabus_topics: Virtual Proof of Reality and Anti-Tamper Radio
Classification of WPLS according to BSI IT-Grundschutz
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon successful completion of the semester-long assignments and passing the final presentation. This is a combined examination. The overall grade component for the B.Sc. IT Security/Information Technology is 5/150.
